run_starlette_app: run the Starlette app serving NLP inference pipelines via POST requests
get_pipeline: get the cached pipeline instance for the TASK and MODEL_ID environment variables
configure_allowed_tasks: configure the ALLOWED_TASKS dict to map task names to Pipeline classes
setup_middleware: setup GZip and optional CORS middleware for the Starlette application
review_startup_event: review the startup_event function that initializes logging and the pipeline
